description: An entry port on the load balancer's address. Without listener: opens one (port and protocol required, up to 5; 22 and 8402 are reserved). https gets certificates for its rules' hostnames; redirect_https makes port 80 redirect to it. A tcp listener needs a tcp default_pool. sources restricts who may connect (null: everyone); with an https listener, port 80 stays open to everyone. Scope: network.write.

default_pool.description: Pool for traffic no rule matches; none answers 503.

lb.description: Load balancer id, as returned by list_load_balancers or create_load_balancer.

sources.description: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or ranges allowed in.

name: upsert_listener
title: Open or update a listener
